title: かたつむり (Katatsumuri — Snail)
description: A short, cheerful children's song asking a snail to show its head and horns. One of the oldest and best-known 文部省唱歌 (Ministry of Education songs), published in 1911 in the first volume of 尋常小学唱歌. Children still sing it while playing with snails during Japan's rainy season (梅雨).
